text:
Situation: Hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 231 tablets (19.9 days at 11.6 tablets per day). Corvale General holds 262 tablets (19 days at 13.8 tablets per day). Corvale Lakeside holds 98 tablets (26.9 days). The top purchasing option is Accord Healthcare Inc., which is also not on the shortage list.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include hydrochlorothiazide as of 2026-10-21. A prior FDA posting shows Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. discontinued its hydrochlorothiazide capsule on 2025-11-19; that product is a capsule, not the tablet strength in use.

Our position: Current tablet inventory across three sites provides approximately 19 to 27 days of supply. Multiple manufacturers not on the shortage list are available for purchase. No FDA shortage designation exists for the tablet presentation.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Accord Healthcare Inc. as primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Actavis Pharma, Inc. as secondary source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Aurobindo Pharma Limited as tertiary source; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes to P&T Committee; requires buyer and P&T chair approval.

Not recommended: Switching to capsule formulations or altering prescribing patterns based on the Teva capsule discontinuation.
